ideas.name: an active day: the 1m ATR above its 20-session RTH average
ideas.why: a breakout needs a market that is moving today; on a quiet day it stalls before the target

ideas.name: an active night: the overnight range half an ADR or more
ideas.why: a busy night means news is being priced; the cash session carries it on

ideas.name: a gap of 0.3 ADR or more either way
ideas.why: a gap is information arriving overnight; the day trends as it is absorbed

ideas.name: yesterday's range 1.2 ADR or more
ideas.why: a wide day is followed by another active one: volatility clusters

ideas.name: VXN up 5% or more yesterday
ideas.why: a jump in implied volatility puts dealers short gamma for the next session: moves extend

ideas.name: VXN in the top third of its last year
ideas.why: a high-volatility regime is where breakouts carry; low regimes pin

ideas.name: the day's high (long) / low (short) made recently: in the last 60 minutes
ideas.why: a market still pressing its extreme has buyers now; an old high is stale

ideas.name: not a quiet day: today's range so far over half an ADR
ideas.why: a day that has not moved by the time of the signal is a range day; its breakouts fail
